test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS k, cityHash64(number) AS h, toUInt32(cityHash64(number, 1)) AS h32, toUInt8(number % 100) AS f FROM numbers(50000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0
test.query: SELECT sum(h), sum(h32) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE f < 100 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(h), sum(h32) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE f < 50 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(h), sum(h32) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE cityHash64(k) % 2 = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(h), sum(h32) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE f != 7 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(h), sum(h32) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_plain_columns.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE f = 7 FORMAT Null
